name: custom_20
description: 20 original prompts written by Team 32, following the three categories of Section 4.2 of the TinyStories paper (factual / reasoning / context-tracking). Vocabulary and syntax deliberately match the TinyStories domain: simple words, short sentences, child-story situations.
notes: These are newly authored prompts, not copied or paraphrased from Figures 9-11.
We have NOT verified that they are absent from the TinyStories training corpus; the paper's own manual n-gram check was not reproduced here.
'expected' is a short grading rubric for human annotation, written before any model was run.

'auto_accept' lists lower-case substrings for a CONSERVATIVE automatic screen. It is a mechanical rendering of 'expected' and is NOT a substitute for human judgement; a hit only means the expected word appears somewhere in the answer.

prompts.expected: Says it melted / started to melt or drip.
